verdict: IDEXX grew revenue 10% to $1.21B as pet diagnostics kept expanding, and profit grew faster — net income rose 15% to $317M as margins widened.

segments.name: Companion Animal Group
segments.note: Diagnostics for dogs and cats: lab instruments, rapid tests and reference-lab services — the core business, with recurring diagnostics revenue up 11%.

segments.name: Water
segments.note: Tests that check water for microbial contamination, sold to utilities and labs.

segments.name: Livestock, Poultry & Dairy
segments.note: Diagnostics that keep farm animals healthy and milk and meat safe.

segments.name: Other
segments.note: Smaller product lines outside the three main groups.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: New analyzers, tests and software — including an AI clinical assistant added by acquisition this quarter.

opex.name: Sales & marketing
opex.note: The sales force and marketing that put IDEXX instruments into vet clinics.

opex.name: General & administrative
opex.note: The back office: finance, legal and company-wide administration.

otherDetail: Interest and other non-operating items, net — a small $3M net cost, even after a gain on an equity investment.

takeaways.title: Diagnostics keep compounding
takeaways.text: CAG Diagnostics recurring revenue grew 11%, led by a 14% jump in VetLab consumables as more clinics ran more tests on a premium instrument base that grew 11%.

takeaways.title: Profit grew faster than sales
takeaways.text: EPS rose 18% to $4.01 — revenue grew 10%, but gross margin widened to 62.9% and costs grew more slowly, so net income climbed 15% to $317M.

takeaways.title: Full-year outlook raised
takeaways.text: IDEXX lifted its 2026 EPS outlook to $14.96–$15.16 (midpoint $15.06), a $0.25 raise, on a stronger revenue outlook.

oneTimers: EPS included a $0.03-per-share benefit from a non-operating gain on an equity investment and $0.01 from share-based compensation tax benefits.
